topic: why airlines earn only a few dollars of profit per passenger even on a full flight
storyAngle: Airlines move billions of people and keep very little per ticket.
doNotClaim: These are IATA industry-wide FORECASTS for 2024, not any one airline or any one ticket.
Do not say a specific airline loses money on a seat.
Do not name any airline, aircraft maker (Airbus, Boeing) or other company: this is the whole industry.

facts.claim: IATA June 2024 forecast: industry NET PROFIT of $30.5 billion in 2024.
IATA forecast net profit MARGIN of 3.1% of revenue.
IATA forecast net profit PER PASSENGER of $6.14.
facts.note: forecast; the CEO called it "just $6.14 per passenger"

facts.claim: IATA forecast total industry REVENUES of $996 billion.
